correctness.rationale: Burek's Lemma 4.1 and Proposition 4.2 give the six exact germs with weighted initial form lambda z^2 + mu s^4 - q(x,y), weights (1,1,1,2), lambda*mu nonzero, and squarefree binary quartic q. The initial Jacobian algebra has dimension 1*3*9=27 because q_x,q_y are a regular sequence of two cubics. All remaining terms have strictly higher weighted degree, so the standard semiquasihomogeneous invariance theorem gives Milnor number 27 for each exact germ. Milnor's bouquet theorem gives reduced H_3 rank 27 and Euler characteristic -26. The packaged checker replays the explicit algebra.
